name: Jersey Soft Play
category: Mobile soft play and party equipment rental
why_selected: Added at the owner's request. Mobile rental of indoor soft-play setups for toddlers: ball pits, wooden slides, rockers, tunnels, foam floor tiles and white picket fencing, delivered and installed at the customer's indoor venue. Four packages run $550-$750 for 4 hours, with add-ons for a small or XL bounce house ($100/$200), custom vinyl ($75), an attendant ($40/hr) and extra time ($100/hr). Now positioned as soft play first with bounce houses as add-ons, and it explicitly does not take outdoor events. Top gap: Turn 'Check Availability' into a real booking path: embed the inquiry form (or a bookable date/availability calendar) on jerseysoftplay.com/booking so the CTA no longer dumps visitors into a third-party tab, and add an option to hold a date with a deposit online.
